test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

The decision not

P. to include any kind of wealth or

Q. crisis, has proven controversial

R. income tax, which would be the fairer option

S. for solving the social care funding
solution:
The correct answer is "**PRSQ**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is **discussing a decision related to social care funding.** The decision was not to include any** kind of wealth or income tax**, which the sentence suggests would have been **a fairer option.**
 
• However, this **decision has proven controversial,** which means that some **people disagree with it or think it was the wrong **choice.
 
• The** rearranged sentence emphasizes the controversy surrounding the decision **by placing the verb phrase "has proven controversial" at the end.
 
• It also puts the key **information about the decision (not to include any kind of tax) at the beginning,** followed by a clarifying phrase about why this would have been fairer for solving the social care funding issue.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence of the sentence would be:* **PRSQ***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The rearranged sentence is:
 
• *The** decision **not to include any kind of **wealth** or **income tax,** which would be the fairer option for** solving th**e social care funding crisis, has proven **controversial.***
